title: Connect physical controllers to the reviewed input ownership model
goal: Connect a pinned host controller backend to the accepted four-slot ownership contract, measuring actual physical-device behavior without guessing guest input mappings.
acceptance: Use the established selected-platform backend where suitable, pin its exact version/configuration, and preserve stable logical local-player ownership separately from device enumeration
Demonstrate four distinguishable physical controllers, disconnect/reconnect, neutral state, late events and independent input without slot/profile theft or solo fallback
Document button/axis normalization, unavailable hardware and backend/device limitations; no borrowed MW2 guest addresses or invented guest input semantics
The accepted MW3-080 API is the dependency contract; split any model/interface change, guest service binding or translated-title input admission before parallel implementation
validation: Run original adapter contracts and real physical-device captures on supported Windows/Linux configurations
Exercise event-order, invalid-device, disconnect/reconnect and wrong-routing controls with supported diagnostics/sanitizers
Run public checks; host device routing does not certify console split-screen, all-mode gameplay or the requested Survival extension
size: bounded physical input backend; title binding is separate
